Curator pool browser

Exactly what the curator receives each rebalance: the ranked article list (title, source, effective lede, and where the lede came from). Effective lede = clean Wayback snapshot if present, else the look-ahead-BIASED live-fallback. Badge: Wayback clean / live URL biased / title only. 105 weeks, 10,500 article rows.
